rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-27 - t8-download-routing [ses_f1d88030affekVeMg7D4CV72oe].md:L08466] A known extension on the **tag-qualified** route (`/api/updater/download/<tag>/<file>.exe`) is deliberately not a route: that path's release is its own authority, and the old test for it is kept as the guard.

nodes.label: The five extension routes read the platform's own channel list via T7's fetchChannelReleases instead of the repository-wide /releases/latest or an unfiltered per_page=10 scan
Documented second lookup stage: a bare legacy tag release is admitted only when it actually carries the file the route serves, and a namespaced other-platform release is never borrowed
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-27 - t8-download-routing [ses_f1d88030affekVeMg7D4CV72oe].md:L08486] A strictly channel-scoped lookup would 404 for `/deb`, `/appimage`, `/apk` while only bare-tag artifacts exist.
